peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (70.7): 4.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 186 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Initial resale-wave effect: 2 of the 4 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Apr 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 16.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 2.9 resales per 100 homes a year over 17 months (May 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 125 of 258 similar developments. First resale wave from May 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date). Observed 24-month activity: 4.2.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Kovan MRT about 740 m, Serangoon MRT about 1,190 m; closer than 124 of 462 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 10 within 2 km; nearest Zhonghua Primary School about 880 m; more than 59 of 462 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 460 m), more than 288 of 462 similar developments (the same as 94); nearest hawker centre Kovan Hougang Market And Food Centre about 940 m; nearest park Surin Ave Neighbourhood Park about 810 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Jansen House, 10 new sales, about 160 m; Chuan Park, 115 new sales, about 1,650 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 136 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 125 new sales and 739 resales (864 purchases); new sales were 14.5% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 739 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 786 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6%). Planning-area private resales −7.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
